elements.element: Customer's indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law

"an allegation that the Site, the Services ... infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right"

No combination exclusion appears in the inserted text

elements.element: Infringement remedies: procure, modify, replace, refund
elements.evidence: Inserted clause contains no procure/modify/replace/refund remedy language

elements.evidence: No cap or super-cap language inserted

offending_extra_words: (provided that no settlement imposing any liability or admission on the Company shall be entered into without the Company's prior written consent)
reasons: All atomic elements of the preferred position are satisfied: defence and indemnity, Customer plus affiliates, the four required triggers (IP infringement, breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach, gross negligence/wilful misconduct), and the notice/control/cooperation mechanics.
The Customer-indemnity limitation element is met by absence: the Agreement creates no Customer indemnity, and the redline does not invent one.

Fallback is not met on several material terms (no modification/combination/specification exclusions, no procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, no 3× super-cap), but that is irrelevant since the locked target is preferred and preferred is complete.

Minimality fails: 'hold harmless' adds protection beyond the preferred prose's defend-and-indemnify duty, and the settlement-consent proviso adds a settlement mechanic beyond the preferred notice, control and cooperation package. Both should be deleted for a strictly minimal insertion.

Intent is preserved: Sections 9(a) and 9(b), including the Globix Agreement carve-out, are untouched, the insertion uses only defined or self-evident terms, and no contradiction or dangling mechanic is introduced.
